svg.title: A stage is not finished because it looks finished.
svg.desc: Each stage closes only when its check, its certificate and its cost are all recorded against it.
svg.text: FOR THE MANAGER ON THE GROUND
Looking done and being signed off are two different events.
Close one stage at a time and the snag list stops growing.
Measured, checked and costed before ring beam.
“The site stops arguing once the stages are closed.”
